answer: An operator running 215 keys hence pays for 215 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the yarrow quota and the whisper admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the walnut ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole swarm at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
